This round could not independently re-fetch the quoted formula text (plain WebFetch on the landing page returns only the abstract, not the linked PDF's methodology annex — the actual download link is a short-lived signed web-api.bps.go.id URL, consistent with this repo's known BPS-Cloudflare-wall trap), so the citation is carried over from the prior round's browser-based session, which explicitly quote-verified it before recording it as a fully-evidenced, verbatim-quotable lead.

reports.title: Survei Biaya Hidup 2022 (Cost of Living Survey 2022)
reports.description: BPS's periodic household cost-of-living survey, which supplies the consumption-basket quantities and base-year consumption values underlying Indonesia's provincial Consumer Price Index (2022=100 base).
reports.cadence_note: Conducted periodically by BPS (editions include 2012, 2018, 2022); interval is not fixed at a set number of years.

dependencies.basis: Nilai konsumsi bulan sebelumnya (P(n-1)i . Qoi), adalah hasil perkalian harga bulan sebelumnya dan kuantitas dari suatu komoditas hasil Survei Biaya Hidup (SBH) 2022. Nilai konsumsi tahun dasar (Poi . Qoi) adalah nilai konsumsi hasil SBH 2022. [provincial practice:] menyesuaikan hasil Survei Biaya Hidup 2022 (SBH 2022) di wilayah masing-masing.
